nodes.title: DLSS5 Neural Render
widgets_values:
## 中文

- **style**：观感。默认 / 自然 / 电影 / 风格3
- **intensity**：总强度 0–1。1=满效果，0.4–0.7=轻抹
- **local_tone**：本地色调。拉低保住原图明暗
- **local_struct**：本地结构。拉低守轮廓，拉高更立体
- **output_view**：处理=成品；差异×10=改动对比；左右对比=左原右结果
- **output_mix**：只在「处理」时生效，原图和结果的混合比例
- **gpu_gen**：Auto 按显卡选 30/40/50 DLL，也可手选

## English

- **style**: Look — Default / Natural / Cinematic / Style 3
- **intensity**: Strength 0–1. 1=full, 0.4–0.7=light
- **local_tone**: Local tone. Lower keeps original exposure
- **local_struct**: Local structure. Lower keeps edges
- **output_view**: Processed / Diff x10 / Left-right compare
- **output_mix**: Blend amount, Processed view only
- **gpu_gen**: Auto-pick RTX 30/40/50 DLL, or set manually

nodes.title: DLSS5 Neural Render (Advanced)
widgets_values:
## 中文

- **style**：观感。默认 / 自然 / 电影 / 风格3
- **intensity**：总强度 0–2，默认 1
- **local_tone**：本地色调。默认 0.5，范围 0–2。拉低保住原图明暗
- **local_struct**：本地结构。默认 0.5，范围 0–2。拉低守轮廓，拉高更立体
- **output_view**：处理=成品；差异×10=改动对比；左右对比=左原右结果
- **output_mix**：只在「处理」时生效，原图和结果的混合比例，0–1
- **gpu_gen**：Auto 按显卡选 30/40/50 DLL，也可手选
- **preset**：0 / 1 / 2 / 3，默认 1。改这项会重建 Feature
- **skin_struct**：皮肤结构 −1–2，默认 1
- **use_auto_mask**：自动遮罩，默认关
- **ui_correction**：UI 校正，默认关

Feature 18 同分辨率下，preset / skin_struct / mask / UI 校正可能几乎没影响。

## English

- **style**: Look — Default / Natural / Cinematic / Style 3
- **intensity**: Strength 0–2, default 1
- **local_tone**: Default 0.5, range 0–2. Lower keeps original exposure
- **local_struct**: Default 0.5, range 0–2. Lower keeps edges
- **output_view**: Processed / Diff x10 / Left-right compare
- **output_mix**: Blend amount 0–1, Processed view only
- **gpu_gen**: Auto-pick RTX 30/40/50 DLL, or set manually
- **preset**: 0 / 1 / 2 / 3, default 1. Changing this recreates the Feature
- **skin_struct**: Skin structure −1–2, default 1
- **use_auto_mask**: Auto mask, off by default
- **ui_correction**: UI correction, off by default

On Feature 18 same-res, preset / skin_struct / mask / UI correction may do little.
